scene.prompt: Turn [image 1], a 3D model, into a photorealistic photograph with the same camera and composition: looking along the portico of a Hellenistic Greek trading house, the sea beyond the columns. The trading house is a finished model: keep every modelled column drum, flagstone, door board, rafter, roof tile, rubble stone and the slotted timber board on its wall exactly where it is, only giving each its real weathered material: lime plaster, grey limestone, timber, terracotta. Add no doors, windows, shelves or racks; the columns stay plain, never fluted. Winter overcast, soft flat light, cloud low on the hills. [image 2] is a reference board: copy its messenger and pouch exactly. Under the portico the bare-headed messenger hands a small folded papyrus slip to a clerk in a plain grey-blue tunic holding a wax tablet. Behind them on the wall hangs the modelled board of slots: each blank tag over a slot carries one painted Greek letter-numeral (Α, Β, Γ, Δ…), never Arabic digits; beside it a loader in a coarse brown tunic lifts a grain sack. No other people. Nothing modern.

b01-goatherd.note: The goatherd on a track high on the spur above House 2's harbour, pointing down to the port; the cliff road round the bay below.

scene.prompt: Turn [image 1], a rough 3D blockout, into a photorealistic photograph with the same camera, composition and landforms: a small Hellenistic Greek port town of stone houses with terracotta roofs below a steep hillside, a long stone pier in the harbour, the sea beyond. Replace every smooth placeholder shape with real maquis, pine, rock, stone and roof tile. The buildings are modelled: keep every building's shape, roof, doors and windows where they are, with whitewashed plaster walls on a low rubble base under terracotta pan-and-cover tile roofs, and earth streets. Winter late morning overcast, cloud low on the hills: soft flat light. In the foreground on a narrow stony goat track among the scrub: a weathered goatherd in a rough undyed wool tunic and a sheepskin cape, holding a crook, with four or five goats around him, pointing down toward the town. Below, a narrow road cut into the hillside runs round the bay into the town. Deep focus, all sharp. No other people. Nothing modern.

scene.prompt: Turn [image 1], a 3D model, into a photorealistic photograph with exactly the same camera and composition: looking along the portico of a Hellenistic Greek trading house, the sea beyond the columns. The trading house is a finished model: keep every modelled column drum, flagstone, door board, rafter, roof tile, rubble stone and the slotted timber board on its wall exactly where it is, only giving each its real weathered material: lime plaster, grey limestone, timber, terracotta. Add no doors, windows, shelves or racks; the columns stay plain, never fluted. Winter overcast, soft flat light. On the wall hangs the modelled board of twelve slots: each blank tag over a slot carries one painted Greek letter-numeral (Α, Β, Γ, Δ…), never Arabic digits; the first five slots hold small clay tablets, the peg stands on its post beside the board. Two clerks, one in a grey-blue tunic and one in an olive tunic, reach for neighbouring slots at once; a loader in a coarse brown tunic walks towards us along the portico with a grain sack on his shoulder.
